summary: The SessionConstants contains various constant string keys used for different views and functionalities within the system, including placement processing, report queue, enrollment, group worksheets, individual worksheets, welcome screens, and others. These constants serve as identifiers for session-related data, filters, URLs, and configurations across various modules.
purpose: To provide a centralized collection of constant keys for managing session-related data and behavior throughout various parts of the application.
system_behavior: Constants are used to manage various application configurations such as views, URL endpoints, filtering options, and sorting preferences.
Session constants are vital for maintaining consistent application behavior across different modules and views.
Constants are categorized based on different aspects or modules like placement, enrollment, group worksheets, etc., each having specific keys for configuration.
